entities.name: Ethyl ester substrate
observations: Contains an ethyl ester, oxadiazole-like ring, hydroxamic-acid side chain, chiral center, and cyclohexylbutyl substituent.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: This is the ester-hydrolysis product in neutral carboxylic-acid form after workup.

entities.name: LiOH aqueous dioxane
observations: Lithium hydroxide in water and 1,4-dioxane promotes selective saponification of the ethyl ester.
Matched conditions report approximately 2.00 hours and 95.4% yield.
